rules: The main notice is addressed only to the primary recipients.
The summary is a second, independent message addressed only to the coordinator.
The coordinator never appears on the main notice - not in To, not in Cc, not in Bcc.
No primary recipient appears on the coordinator summary - not in To, not in Cc, not in Bcc.
The summary is not a reply to, forward of, or thread continuation of the main notice.
